messages:
Anya: Heads up — canary on ded-cluster-3 (model: rwd-v2-7b-quant) started showing a tail latency/regression after we flipped act_quant + group_size=32 last night. p95 went 120ms -> ~620ms, errors ~0.6% (was ~0.02%).

Jordan: :eyes: which route? is this only on long context requests or everywhere?

Anya: Mostly chat-route /v1/generate with avg seq=512. Short prompts (<=32) look fine. Errors are mostly timeouts and a few "decode-hang: kv-iter stuck" traces.

Matt: I pulled the runtime traces from the canary. snippet: ```
2026-03-19T02:14:01Z serve[pid=4121] INFO batch=87 group_size=32 step=15 p99=1.2s p95=620ms
2026-03-19T02:14:03Z serve[pid=4121] WARN kvcache: miss_spike=312/1m
2026-03-19T02:14:04Z serve[pid=4121] ERROR decode: hung_allocator wait>10s
```

Sylvie: Huh. kv miss spike + group size increase could be thrashing the prefix cache. AWQ act-quant path does some extra per-group reductions that increase memory churn. Could be allocator fragmentation.

Anya: We rolled this change as part of the "actq-b1" bake (group_size=32, act_quant=1.0). Rollout-bot logged: `rollout-bot: deployed actq-b1 to canary pool ded-cluster-3 at 2026-03-19T01:48:22Z`.

rollout-bot: Canary deployment completed (4/4 healthy). Metrics: rps=420, latency-up=+4.3x/p95.

Jordan: Quick hypothesis list: 1) group_size=32 interacts poorly with prefix/KV caching threshold, 2) act-quant math path triggers intermittent NaN/inf in attention scale causing retries, 3) packing/batching change increased per-request memory.

Matt: I reran a small replay locally with same model and inputs. Differences: 
- group_size=16, act_quant=true => p95 ~180ms, p99 ~320ms
- group_size=32, act_quant=false => p95 ~140ms, p99 ~260ms
- group_size=32, act_quant=true => p95 ~610ms, p99 >1s and sporadic hangs

Sylvie: Can you paste the config fragment you deployed?

Matt: ```json
{
  "serve_route": "/v1/generate",
  "model": "rwd-v2-7b-quant",
  "quant": { "type": "awq", "act_quant": true, "group_size": 32 },
  "batching": { "max_tokens": 1024, "max_batch_size": 64 }
}
```

Anya: Also noticed GC/allocator logs: `jemalloc: background_decay paused` and a bunch of `madvise` churn during p95 spikes. Might be getting into swap-ish behavior on the instance (memory spikes correlate).

Jordan: Two quick experiments to isolate: A) flip act_quant=false on canary group_size=32 (no other changes) B) keep act_quant=true but reduce group_size to 16. If A fixes it, act-quant path is culprit. If B fixes it, group-size/KV interaction likely. Both were quick to run in staging.

Sylvie: I'll run A first (less risk). Anya, can you open a canary patch and pin just the act_quant flag? Keep a rollback ready. Use tag actq-toggle-174999.

Anya: Created patch and started rollout to ded-cluster-3 canary: `actq-toggle-174999` -> applying now.

rollout-bot: Started rollout actq-toggle-174999 to ded-cluster-3 (4 instances).

Matt: While that goes, I replayed 5k requests over the same trace. With act_quant=false & group_size=32, no hangs, p95 ~150ms. So likely act-quant arithmetic path + large groupsize -> memory / slowdowns.

Anya: actq-toggle shows 4/4 healthy and p95 back near baseline. Error rate down to 0.03%.

Sylvie: Good. Next steps: 1) don't promote actq-b1 to production yet. 2) run focused microbenchmarks on the AWQ act-quant kernel with group_size sweep [8,16,24,32,48]. 3) add telemetry counters in runtime for `actq_overflow`, `actq_norm_clip`, `kv_evictions` to catch early signs.

Jordan: Also add a CI regression test that runs a short 1k-infer microloop with act_quant on group_size=32 to catch perf regressions before canary.

Matt: I'll prepare a PR with bench harness and a small dumplog parser to correlate jemalloc/madvise spikes to actq steps.

Anya: TL;DR: act_quant=true + group_size=32 caused canary instability (likely memory churn / kv-cache thrash). Rollback of act_quant fixed canary. We need a kernel-level fix or fallback that disables act-quant for large group sizes automatically.

Sylvie: Agree. Also let's consider a temporary runtime safeguard: if p95 > 2x baseline in canary within 10m, auto-disable act_quant on canary instances and alert.

Jordan: :thumbsup: thanks team. Matt/Aanya/Sylvie — sync in 30 to review bench results and decide production policy.

Anya: Ping in this thread when benches finish, attaching logs and flamegraphs.

Matt: Will do. Flamegraph ETA ~45m.

rollout-bot: Rollout actq-toggle-174999 completed. Canary stable.
